subject.title: feat(plugins): add cron reconciliation lifecycle hook

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the repaired `cron_reconciled` event as a permanent public Plugin SDK lifecycle contract?
rationale: The two correctness blockers have mechanical repairs, but adding and supporting another third-party hook with authoritative ordering guarantees requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Adopt after repairs and proof
options.body: Keep the narrow hook after readiness and timeout fixes, current-main integration, live plugin proof, and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep the SDK unchanged
options.body: Decline the new event and document an existing supported reconciliation workflow instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repairs and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow hook after readiness and timeout fixes, current-main integration, live plugin proof, and compatibility review.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and blame make steipete the strongest available owner for the public Plugin SDK and Gateway lifecycle choice.
